name: stegwerk
description: Open-source CRM for small and mid-sized businesses in Germany: deals, quotes, GoBD invoices, XRechnung, DATEV.

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck && npm run check:queries
scripts.test: npm --workspace server run test && npm --workspace web run test
